settings.question: Are your products crash-tested and certified for car travel?
settings.answer: Yes. All Canitera travel restraints and safety seatbelts are crafted with high-tensile nylon webbing, heavy-duty alloy hardware, and tested to withstand high-impact forces. We advise securing harnesses directly into ISOFIX or factory seatbelt receptacles.

settings.question: How long does delivery take across Europe?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours from our European warehouse. Standard shipping takes 2–4 business days. Free shipping is automatically applied at checkout on all orders over €75.

settings.question: Will your seat covers and beds fit my vehicle model?
settings.answer: Our seat liners and all-terrain beds feature universal sizing with adjustable headrest anchors, side-flaps, and tuck-in seat anchors designed to fit SUVs, estates, hatchbacks, and saloons perfectly.

settings.question: How do I clean mud and sand from Canitera gear?
settings.answer: All fabric covers unzip and are 100% machine-washable at 30°C. For daily maintenance on road trips, simple shaking and wiping down with a damp cloth is all that's required.

settings.question: What is the 30-day adventure trial?
settings.answer: We want you to test Canitera gear on real journeys. If it doesn't make travelling with your companion simpler and more comfortable, you can return it within 30 days for a full refund.
